svg.title: HotShift architecture
svg.desc: Clients call a FastAPI process whose batch scheduler feeds a single engine worker thread. The host engine deduplicates IDs, probes the GPU slot map, packs misses from a memory-mapped CPU table, pools on the GPU, lets the policy choose admissions and evictions, and applies them with scatter and map-update kernels.
svg.text: A bounded GPU cache in front of a CPU-resident embedding table: how one microbatch flows from HTTP to the GPU and back
React + Vite · polls status and metrics

unique IDs, miss rows, descriptors, offsets, outputs · reused after their copy event

cache_rows[C × D] · FP32 · 51 MB (10% of rows) + device miss staging

svg.text: 1–5 run in order for every microbatch; ⏸ marks a host wait on a CUDA event (probe_done, output_done, maintenance_done). The pipeline is serialized: no host planning overlaps device work.
